paper.title: AgentFactory: A Self-Evolving Framework Through Executable Subagent Accumulation and Reuse
paper.central_claim: 通过生成、执行反馈改进和持久化Python子agent，在后续任务和外部框架复用，实现持续能力积累及更高效率。

provenance.notes: 按调用配置为sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无可独立验证的实际模型回执/会话标识，不探测。

sections_read: Appendix B all; Tables1–3; figure captions1–3

evidence.quote: Successfully executed subagents are saved as executable code, forming a growing library of reusable capabilities.

Upon successful completion, the Meta-Agent evaluates the subagent and decides which skills to save as reusable skills. Each saved subagent consists of pure Python code with an accompanying SKILL.md file documenting its functionality, parameters, and usage.
evidence.support_explanation: 代码与文档持久化，判断门控仍由Meta-Agent。

evidence.quote: The modified subagent is tested against the current task to verify the improvement.
evidence.support_explanation: 当前任务验证，不是独立回归门。

evidence.quote: These built-in skills remain fixed and provide fundamental primitives for agent lifecycle management.
evidence.support_explanation: 改的是子agent代码，不是改进器本身。

evidence.quote: In Run 3, the Meta-Agent replaced it with regex-based extraction, making parsing more robust.
evidence.support_explanation: 只有轨迹示例支持修补，不是鲁棒率统计。

evidence.quote: Token counts exclude subagent-internal LLM consumption.
evidence.support_explanation: 成本仅是编排模型输出token，非总LLM成本。

evidence.quote: We ensure that all tasks are completed without runtime errors in all experiments.
evidence.support_explanation: 运行无错误不等于产物语义正确。

signatures.selection_rule: Meta-Agent在成功完成后决定保存；修改只在当前任务验证
signatures.persistence: 持久技能库，finish保存；退役/版本冲突策略未报告

signatures.failure_boundary: runtime通过非语义正确；近模板复用；子agent成本未计

gap.author_gap: 文本反思不能可靠高效地重新执行复杂流程；通用程序性工作流需要可执行能力累积。
